title: example-targets runtime R3: run_verifier on the fixture's five proof tasks, native strict, with the real jvmcontract
description: The runtime stream's R3 (llm-dlc/loops/example-targets-runtime.md) replaced Phase 0's run_verifier stub in examples/tools/targets/runtime.py: jvmcontract prove or equivalence on a task's prepared original JARs, never the adapter or driver, with the plan's engine and gap mode, the claim's bounds and statement, a static gap scan as the capability probe, and the scope label recorded, as one raw verifier ExecutionRecord. Its unit tests use a stand-in jvmcontract, so this job is the first run with the real one. Step 1 runs examples/tools/targets/runtime_calibrate.py: each proof task of Phase 0's fixture (examples/tools/targets/fixtures/target.json) is prepared by runtime.prepare and checked by runtime.run_verifier with --engine native --gaps strict, its claim being the property workflow's fixture claim files state (assert '!result || (code != 65 && code != 97)' on fixture.Gate#allowed(int); RegexGate's '!result || field != null'), and the record handed to workflow.ingest (still Phase 0's stub on this branch). Step 2 runs the integration contract with JVMCONTRACT set, so A5 gets past its jvmcontract skip and stops at workflow's task-plan stub. No upstream code is fetched or built: the fixture is local.
expected: both steps exit 0. Step 1 prints 'as expected' for all five tasks and ends 'ok': vulnerable-security a violation (its witness at code 97), fixed-security verified, mutant-security a violation (at 65), preservation (equivalence of before and after outside code == 97) verified, and regex-probe unverifiable with output naming java.util.regex; each scope constructed-fixture. Step 2: the contract passes, A5's two rows skipped at 'unsupported: task-plan (example-targets-workflow)', not for want of jvmcontract

resources.notes: five native strict proofs of a one-line int method, plus five static gap scans and ten small javac/jar builds (about 2 s each inline); the jvmcontract build is the runner's
